facts.text: A law is a state-enforceable rule; a regulation and a directive are two forms of European Union law; a guidance note is official compliance advice that is not itself law.
facts.quote: A law is a rule the state can enforce, a regulation and a directive are two forms that European Union law takes, and a guidance note is official advice that explains how to comply without itself being law.

facts.text: United States rule 29 CFR 1926.601 requires a reverse alarm or an observer when a machine's rear view is blocked.
facts.quote: United States rule 29 CFR 1926.601, which requires a reverse alarm or an observer when a machine's rear view is blocked

facts.text: South Africa's Mine Health and Safety Regulation 8.10 requires automatic braking on diesel trackless mobile machines.
facts.quote: South Africa's Mine Health and Safety Regulation 8.10, which requires automatic braking on diesel trackless mobile machines

facts.text: The EU Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies directly and identically in every EU member state from 20 January 2027, without national rewriting.
facts.quote: A regulation applies directly and identically in every member state from a fixed date; the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies from 20 January 2027 with no national rewriting

facts.text: The Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 replaces the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC.
facts.quote: the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, which the Regulation replaces

facts.text: The Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026.
facts.quote: the Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853, applying to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026

facts.text: United States federal rules are in the Code of Federal Regulations; 30 CFR 75.1732 denotes title 30, part 75, section 1732.
facts.quote: United States federal rules sit in the Code of Federal Regulations: "30 CFR 75.1732" is title 30, part 75, section 1732

facts.text: Australia's model Work Health and Safety regulations bind only once a state or territory adopts them.
facts.quote: Australia has "model" Work Health and Safety regulations that bind only once a state or territory adopts them

facts.text: South Africa's Regulation 8.10 was promulgated in 2015, but its braking clauses commenced on 21 December 2022.
facts.quote: Regulation 8.10 was promulgated in 2015 and its braking clauses commenced on 21 December 2022

facts.text: Regulators' guidance notes are not binding, but inspectors use them to interpret compliance with law.
facts.quote: A guidance note is official advice from a regulator about how to meet the law. It is not binding, but inspectors use it.

facts.text: Queensland's Guidance Note QGN 33 explicitly states that it is not a Recognised Standard.
facts.quote: Queensland's Guidance Note QGN 33 says of itself that it "is not a Recognised Standard"

facts.text: India's mines-safety circulars are official guidance and enforcement material.
facts.quote: India's mines-safety circulars are "official guidance and enforcement material"

facts.text: Australia's Code of Practice on plant is official explanatory material.
facts.quote: Australia's Code of Practice on plant is "the official explanatory material"

facts.text: Interpretation letters from OSHA, the United States construction safety agency, accept a camera or radar as an alternative to a reverse alarm under conditions and play a role similar to guidance notes.
facts.quote: Interpretation letters from OSHA, the United States construction safety agency, which accept a camera or radar as an alternative to a reverse alarm under conditions, play a similar role

facts.text: The booklet's regional survey found a hard automatic-braking mandate only in South Africa, warning and risk-program duties in the United States, general machinery law in the EU and Britain, and guidance notes in Australia and India.
facts.quote: a hard automatic-braking mandate only in South Africa, warning and risk-program duties in the United States, general machinery law in the EU and Britain, and guidance notes in Australia and India.

facts.text: None of the regional legal and guidance regimes surveyed sets a complete numeric test for automatic braking; most acceptance criteria must therefore come from standards, customer specifications and the manufacturer's own safety case.
facts.quote: None sets a complete numeric test for automatic braking, so most acceptance criteria must come from standards, customer specifications and the manufacturer's own safety case
